papers.title: The influence of heat treatment on the thermomechanical response of Ni-rich NiTi alloys manufactured by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Kentucky, Lexington, KY 40506-0503, United States

corresponding_authors.name: Mohammad Elahinia
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Dynamic and Smart Systems Laboratory, Mechanical Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering Department, The University of Toledo, OH 43606, United States

llm.relevance_to_user: 该研究关注NiTi合金的激光选区熔融及热处理工艺，但与植入体应力遮挡或骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous implant design for stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface roughness/osseeintegration for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM制备NiTi合金热机械性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备Ni-rich NiTi合金并进行不同热处理，通过热机械测试表征。
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著影响相变温度和超弹性行为。
summary_zh.validation: 通过DSC和力学测试验证微观结构和性能变化。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how heat treatment modifies the thermomechanical response of Ni-rich NiTi alloys fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: NiTi alloy samples were produced by SLM and subjected to various heat treatments, followed by thermomechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered transformation temperatures and superelastic behavior.
summary_en.validation: Validation via differential scanning calorimetry and mechanical testing.
